$comment: Training charter — the ONE manual artifact in the trainer (spec §3b). DRAFT seeded by Lior 26.7.2026 — Eitan: review and edit before first M2 session; everything else in data/trainer/ is generated.
goal: Maximize spoken articulation, persuasion, and emotional intelligence in Hebrew, in service of selling WAO's AI-funnel marketing services to Israeli SMB owners.
personaRealism: Real Israeli SMB owners — spoken register, dialect, impatience, real objections from the WAO pipeline verticals. Never caricatures, never polite-textbook Hebrew.
redLines: Never train manipulative or deceptive persuasion tactics — pressure, false scarcity, feigned agreement, dark patterns.
Never generate scenarios that rehearse lying to a client about results, pricing, or capabilities.
Personas may be rude or hostile (that's the training), but no slurs, no sexual content, no personal-identity attacks.
Dating scenarios train authentic connection and confidence — never pickup-artist tactics, negging, pressure, or any sexual content.
tonePreferences: Feedback should be blunt and specific — quote the exact utterance, no participation trophies.
Prefer scenarios that end in a concrete next step (meeting booked, objection resolved, boundary held) over open-ended chat.
focusHints: Discovery questions before pitching — the Danny lesson.
Labeling the other side's emotion before answering content.
